name: Flame of Phoenix
source:
FoP is an adult furry visual novel focusing on your life in the prestigious Phoenix Academy. There are 5 main characters that are seen as love interests in the game, each of which will have their own unique route. The VN will also explore the main character's own story arc which can change depending on the choices you make. 

[From [url=https://phoenixproject.itch.io/flame-of-phoenix]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
FoP是一部毛茸茸的成人视觉小说，聚焦于你在著名的凤凰学院的生活。游戏中有5位被视为恋爱对象的主要角色，每个角色都有自己独特的路线。VN还将探索主角自己的故事情节，该故事情节可能会根据你所做的选择而改变。

[来自[url=https://phoenixproject.itch.io/flame-of-phoenix]Itch.io[/url]]
